actual_checks: Full prompt, wrappers, source notes, report and provenance read; no priors listed. Partial-result categorization is appropriate: a finite one-sided negative certificate for a supplied planar monodromy, with an infinite family of obstructions, rather than a fillability/tightness decision algorithm.

Checked the fixed supporting planar open book and allowable homologically nontrivial vanishing cycles. Wendl makes strong and Stein existence equivalent here; exact existence lies between them. Weak fillings are excluded from the claim.

Annular capping homomorphisms h_i and pure-two-braid full-twist exponents l_ij have the stated indicator contributions for every nonempty enclosed hole set A, including outer-boundary-parallel curves. Positive-factor counts c_A satisfy both equations. If all h_i>=0, H=sum h_i gives sum |A|c_A=H, bounding every c_A and number of factors; H=0 is handled by the unique zero vector.

For k>=1 and a curve enclosing at least two holes, the chosen pair has l_ij=-k, while every single-hole boundary twist has zero pair contribution, irrespective of r_i. Passing the integer test is not asserted sufficient: same hole subset need not determine isotopy class or ordered nonabelian product.

scope_and_distinctness.exact_scope: For a fixed planar open book, Wendl's theorem converts strong/Stein fillability into positive allowable factorization of that same monodromy. The report proves an effective finite nonnegative-integer obstruction using annular and pairwise multiplicities, with an explicit infinite family ruled out. This is a one-sided obstruction, not a general tightness or fillability decider; weak fillability is not covered.
